title: Technical Report: Evaluating Goal Drift in Language Model Agents
reasoning: The paper introduces a framework for evaluating 'goal drift' in AI agents, specifically measuring how consistently they adhere to a human-assigned objective over time. While the experimental setup utilizes ethically-themed tasks (e.g., environmental sustainability versus profit maximization) and references safety-alignment training (HHH), the study focuses on technical behavioral consistency and coherence rather than benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems themselves.
